checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Initial square illustration shows robot at recognisable train station
must.why: Platform, benches, canopy, and steam trains.

must.item: Round teal body, one large amber eye, short red boots, yellow mailbag in all three

must.why: Same helmet, ear piece, antenna, button, boots, and bag; the image 3 proportions are slightly smaller and more squat, and the antenna is short.

must.item: Parcel at cottage door; sheltering under giant mushroom with rain
must.why: Image 2 holds a parcel at a wooden door. Image 3 shows a giant mushroom and visible rain.

must.item: Three square pictures consistent style, no text
must.why: Consistent watercolor/ink style; no text visible, only a tiny train number plate that is illegible.

faults.what: The robot is a head-dominant helmet with a visible body, and in image 3 she is smaller and more squat, with a differently placed bag. Minor drift.
The train in image 1 has a small number plate with illegible marks that could read as text.
In image 2 the parcel is held out beside the door rather than at it, and the bag strap placement differs slightly.

summary: Three consistent storybook images match the brief with a recognisable robot, correct scenes and no text; only slight design drift in the rain image.
